description: : You gain a +2 bonus on all Diplomacy and Intimidate checks made to influence orcs. Additionally, as long as you are visibly leading them, all your followers gain a +1 morale bonus on their attack rolls and Will saving throws

name: --Breathing Link--
description: : As a free action on your turn, you may select one creature within 5 feet of you and give that creature the ability to breathe water as easily as you do.

name: Calishite Elementalist
description: : You gain +1 caster level when casting a spell from the Air tradition or Fire tradition, depending on which tradition you select when you choose this feat. This bonus caster level allows you to exceed the normal maximum damage allowed by a spell.

name: Celestial Bloodline
prerequisites: Aasimar, Base Fort, Ref, and Will +1
description: : You gain the ability to use protection from evil three times per day and bless once per day as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to your character level.

name: Chondathan Missionary
prerequisites: Chondathan human, ability to cast divine spells
description: : You gain +1 caster level when casting a spell from the listed spells, or +2 caster level if you’re actually using the spell to proselytize to a reasonably receptive audience (indifferent attitude or better).

name: Deepening Darkness
prerequisites: Able to create darkness as a racial ability
description: : The darkness you create with your racial ability is treated as deeper darkness for the purpose of countering or being countered by spells such as daylight.  You may now use it 3x/day.

name: Duergar Mindshaper
description: : You gain +1 spell power (+1 on save DCs and a +1 bonus on checks to overcome spell resistance) on enchantment spells and spell-like abilities.

name: Eldritch Linguist
prerequisites: Illuskan human, ability to cast divine spells
description: : You gain +1 caster level when casting one of the listed spells.

name: Elemental Bloodline
prerequisites: Base Fort +4, Genasi (air, earth, fire, or water)
description: : You gain a +4 saving throw bonus on saving throws against poison, sleep, paralysis, or stunning. You also have a chance to turn a critical hit or a sneak attack against you into a normal hit (as if you were wearing light fortification armor).

name: Enervative Healing
prerequisites: Fey'ri, ability to use enervation as a spell-like ability
description: : When you use your enervation ability, you may choose to touch an opponent instead of firing a ray, making a melee touch attack to do so. You heal 5 hit points for every negative level the target gains from this attack.

name: Eyes Of Light
description: : Once per day you may fire a ray of searing light from your eyes as a spell-like ability. Your caster level for this ability is your character level.

name: Fiendish Bloodline
prerequisites: Fey'ri, tanarukk, tiefling, Base Fort, Ref, and Will +1
description: : You gain the ability to cast protection from good three times per day and bane once per day as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to your character level.

name: Forest Gnome Phantasist
description: : Your Illusion (pattern) and Illusion (phantasm) spells and spell-like abilities gain +1 spell power (+1 on save DCs and +1 bonus on checks to overcome spell resistance).

name: Gold Dwarf Dweomersmith
description: : You gain +1 caster level when casting a spell that creates a weapon or enhances an existing one.

name: Hammer Fist
description: : You add one and a half times your Strength bonus or your damage when you hit with an unarmed strike. This extra damage does not apply if you make a flurry of blows attack or you are holding anything in either hand.

name: Headlong Rush
description: : Instead of a normal charge attack, you can perform a headlong rush that deals double damage to the target, but provokes AoO's from all within 5' of the path and the target.

name: Healing Flames
prerequisites: Base Will +3, Fire Genasi or Tanarukk
description: : When you use your control flame spell-like ability, you instead may touch the flame and heal yourself a number of hit points of damage depending upon the size of the fire.

name: --Highborn Drow--
description: : You may use detect good, detect magic, and levitate once per day as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to your character level.

name: Hin Wandermage
description: : You gain +1 caster level when casting a spell that helps you travel. If you are a wizard, you gain a spell in your tradition for free when you become able to cast it. This does not count against the two free spells at each class level.

name: Improved Energy Resistance
prerequisites: Naturally resistant to a form of energy (acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic) (not verified)
description: : Your resistance to that type of energy increases by 1 step.

name: Improved Levitation
prerequisites: Naturally able to levitate as a spell-like ability(not verified)
description: : You may use your levitate spell-like ability in 10-minute increments instead of all at once. The number of times per day you may now use the ability at this shorter duration is equal to your caster level.

name: Infernal Bargainer
description: : Whenever you cast commune, contact other plane, legend lore, or vision, you gain +2 caster level because you are known to the entities answering your entreaties.

name: Light To Daylight
prerequisites: Able to use light as a spell-like ability (not verified)
description: : When using your spell-like ability to create light, you may instead create daylight.  You may now use the ability 3x per day.

name: Lightbringer
prerequisites: Damaran human, able to cast divine spells, able to turn undead
description: : Whenever you cast a spell, you can expend three of your daily turn attempts to infuse the spell with positive energy. Each round you do this immediately prior to casting the spell, you gain +2 spell power.

name: Lolth's Blessing
prerequisites: Drow Elf, Wis 15, patron deity Lolth, able to cast 3rd-level divine spells
description: : You may use clairaudience/clairvoyance, detect lie, dispel magic, and suggestion once per day as spell-like abilities with a caster level equal to your character level.

name: Low Blow
description: : As a full-round action, you can enter an area occupied by someone at least one size larger than you. You make a single melee attack at your highest attack bonus, your opponent is considered flat-footed for this attack.

name: Improved Low Blow
description: : Using the Low Blow feat does not provoke an attack of opportunity when you move into an opponent’s square to perform the attack.

name: Might Makes Right
description: : Add your Strength bonus to your leadership score for the purposes of determining how many followers you may have with the Leadership feat.

name: Outsider Wings
prerequisites: Aasimar or tiefling, Base Fort, Ref, and Will +2, Celestial Bloodline or Fiendish Bloodline
description: : You gain wings (feathered if an aasimar, batlike if a tiefling), allowing you to fly at your land speed (average maneuverability). A medium or heavy load that would reduce your land speed reduces your fly speed a proportionate amount.

name: Planetouched Animal Affinity
description: : Choose a divine ancestor. You gain a +4 bonus on Wild Empathy and Handle Animal checks when dealing with similar animals. You may make untrained Wild Empathy checks to affect such animals, as well as celestial or fiendish animals as if they were animals.

name: --Primitive Caster--
description: : This feat only functions when you cast a spell that does not already have a verbal, somatic; or material component. For each one, you increase the effective level of the spell by +1. You can only add a component that’s not already present in the spell.

name: --Rapid Swimming--
description: : Your swim speed increases by 20 feet.

name: Reckless Offensive
description: : Before making attack rolls for a round, you may choose to take a -4 penalty to your AC during the round to gain a +2 competence bonus on all melee attacks in the same round. The penalty to AC and bonus on melee attacks apply until your next action.

name: Rock Gnome Trickster
description: : Your Illusion (glamer) spells and spell-like abilities gain +1 spell power (+1 on save DCs and +1 bonus on checks to overcome spell resistance).

name: Runesmith
description: : You can make runes that take the place of traditional material components for spells you cast. The runes cost 1 gp each and have a Craft (rune) DC of 15. Unlike a material component, a rune does not disappear when you cast a spell.

name: Sacred Tattoo
prerequisites: Patron deity from the Mulhorandi or Untheric pantheon (not verified)
description: : Add +1 to the DC for all saving throws against spells you cast in an area consecrated/desecrated or hallowed/unhallowed to your deity. You get a +1 bonus on caster level checks to beat a creature’s spell resistance when casting spells in such areas.

name: Shield Dwarf Warder
description: : You gain +1 caster level when casting a spell that creates or enhances a suit of armor or a shield. Additionally, any magic armor or shield you create costs 5% less gold pieces to make. The experience point cost is unaffected.

name: Southern Magician
prerequisites: Mulan human, ability to cast 2nd-level spells
description: : Once per day per two spellcaster levels, you can cast a divine spell as an arcane spell, or vice versa.

name: Spell-like Ability Focus
description: : Add +2 to the DC for all saving throws against the spell-like ability on which you focus.

name: Spell-like Ability Focus x2
description: : Add +2 to the DC for all saving throws against the spell-like ability on which you focus.

name: Spell-like Ability Focus x3
description: : Add +2 to the DC for all saving throws against the spell-like ability on which you focus.

name: --Staggering Strike--
description: : If you hit with a sneak attack, you may forgo a variable number of dice of sneak attack damage to deliver a serious . The victim becomes staggered for a number of rounds equal to one-third the number of dice of damage you choose to forgo .

name: Stone Colossus
description: : When you use the attack action or full attack action in melee, you can take a penalty of as much as -5 on your attack and add the same number (up to +5) to your Armor Class as a natural armor bonus.

name: Stone Slide
description: : Instead of using your spell-like ability to pass without trace, you may instead meld into stone as a 5th-level druid. This uses your ability to pass without trace for the day.

name: Stoneblood
description: : When dying, you have a 50% chance per round to stabilize and stop bleeding to death.

name: Stonewalker Fist
description: : By altering the structure of your fists you may ignore up to a +4 armor bonus due to metal or stone armor or shields. You cannot use this ability on creatures with the earth subtype. Using this ability is a free action.

name: Stonewalker Fist x2
description: : By altering the structure of your fists you may ignore up to a +4 armor bonus due to metal or stone armor or shields. You cannot use this ability on creatures with the earth subtype. Using this ability is a free action.

name: Summon Earth Elemental
description: : Once per day, you may summon an earth elemental. If acting alone, you may only summon a Small earth elemental. For each additional deep gnome employing this feat in conjunction with you, you may summon an earth elemental one size larger.

name: Svirfneblin Figment Master
description: : Your Illusion (figment) spells and spell-like abilities gain +1 spell power (+1 on save DCs and +1 bonus on checks to overcome spell resistance).

name: Talfirian Song
prerequisites: Bardic music class feature, Heighten Spell, Tethyrian human
description: : By expending uses of your bardic music, you can heighten your illusion spells without using higher-level spell slots. For each use of your bardic music you expend, you can increase the effective level of that spell by +1.

name: Tattoo Magic
prerequisites: Craft (calligraphy) or Craft (painting) skill, spellcaster level 3rd
description: : You can create a tattoo of any spell of 3rd level or lower that you know and that targets a creature or creatures. Creating a tattoo takes 1 hour, and it must be inked onto a creature with a corporeal body.

name: Shadowform Familiar
prerequisites: Krinth, summon familiar class feature (not verified)

name: Shadowstrike
description: : You gain +1 bonus on attacks and deal +1d6 damage with melee weapon in shadowy conditions

name: Skewer Foe

description: : If you hit the same target more than one time in a turn with a piercing melee weapon, each extra attack deals an extra 1d6 point of damage

description: : You may take a trophy from a fallen victim as a free action

name: Doomspeak

description: : Target takes a -10 penalty on attacks, saves, ability check, and skill checks for 1 round

name: Profane Outburst
prerequisites: Ability to rebuke undead, any evil alignment
description: : You can spend a rebuke attempt to grant undead within 60 ft. a +1 profane bonus to AC

name: Via Negativa
description: : You may spend rebuke attempt to deal extra damage with an inflict spells that you cast.

name: Initiate of Ghaunadaur
description: : You may command/rebuke oozes 3+ Cha mod times per day. You may also add spells to cleric spell list

name: Initiate of Gruumsh
prerequisites: Orc or half-orc, ability to cast 2nd level divine spells, patron deity Gruumsh
description: : Cast prepared cure spells or spontaneously cast inflict spells as a swift action. You may also add spells to the cleric spell list

name: Initiate of Kossuth
description: : Fire Elementals you summon have max hit points. You can add spells to the cleric spell list.

name: Initiate of Loviatar
description: : You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and saving throws against fear for 1 min./level after taking damage.

name: --Initiate of Shar--
description: No description available.

name: Initiate of Varae
prerequisites: Extaminaar, cleric level 3rd, patron deity Varae
description: : Create shield of emerald scales (1/day for 1 min./level) that ignores certain force effects. You add spells to the cleric spell list.

description: No description available.

name: Reaping Spell

name: Tormented Knight

description: : Weapon wielded is treated as  evil for the purpose of overcoming DR. Successful attacks deal 1d4 Cha damage to lawful or chaotic outsiders.

name: Caramendine Monk

description: : Use Int modifier in place of Wis modifier for monk abilities. Treat your monk level as one higher for a selected monk ability.

name: Detect Shadow Weave User

name: Druuth Slayer
description: : You gain a +1 bonus on Will saves; recognize shapechanged doppelgangers; new save vs. mind flayer's mind blast each round.

name: From Smite to Song

name: Overcome Shadow Weave
prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks, Spellcraft 5 ranks, spellcaster who uses the Weave (not verified)
description: : Gain a +5 bonus to caster level checks to detect, counterspell, and dispel Shadow Weave effects; +1 bonus competence bonus on Will saves vs. Shadow Weave effects.

name: Silver Blood
description: : Immune to lycanthropy; if a lycanthrope bites you it must make a Fort save or take damage.

name: Silver Fang
prerequisites: Base Fortitude save +4, member or ally of the Fangshields (not verified)
description: : All your natural attacks and unarmed strikes count as silver weapons for the purpose of overcoming DR.

name: Smiting Power
description: : Add your smite bonuses to bull rush or overrun.

name: Sword of the Arcane Order
prerequisites: Int 13, Paladin 4th of Azuth or Mystra or Ranger 4th of Mystra, (member of the Knights of the Mystic Fire, Order of the Shooting Star, or Swords of the High One (not verified))
description: : You can use your paladin or ranger spell slots to prepare wizard spells that you know. You may add paladin and ranger levels to your wizard level to determine your wizard caster level.

name: Sun Soul Monk
prerequisites: Monk 4th, member of Sun Soul Order (not verified)
description: : See feat description.

name: Mark of the Triad

description: No description available.

name: Knight of the Red Falcon

description: : You gain +1 morale bonus to AC when adjacent to multiple foes.

name: Knight of the Risen Scepter

name: Knight of Tyr's Holy Judgment

name: Knight of Tyr's Merciful Sword

name: Initiate of Milil

description: : Your bard, cleric, and paladin levels stack to determine which bardic music abilities you can use; spend turn attempt to activate bardic music; add spells to spell list.

name: Initiate of Nobanion

name: Brand of the Nine Hells
description: : You gain a benefit based on your alleigance to a Lord of the Nine.

name: Mark of Avernus
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Bel
description: : Once per encounter, make a single melee attack, ranged attack, or use a spell-like ability as an immediate action. Gain +4 to attack and damage and automatically confirm crits made as part of readied actions.

name: Mark of Cania
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Mephistopheles
description: : Whenever you fail at an attack, gain cumulative bonus on attacks, saves, and checks until you succeed.

name: Mark of Dis
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Dispater
description: : When you move, the square you start in is nor considered threatened. Once per round as an immeidate action, you may gain +4 to a save or to AC.

name: Mark of Maladomini
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Baalzebul
description: : Creatures moving near you must make a DC 9 Balance check or stop moving. Creatures within 10ft must make a DC 9 Fort save or be sickened for 10 rounds.

name: Mark of Malbolge
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Glasya
description: : You have 3 fleshy tumours that you can use to gain a variety of effects.

name: Mark of Minauros
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Mammon
description: : When you charge, gain a +2 bonus to attack for every 10ft travelled. When you move, the square you start in is not considered threatened.

name: Mark of Nessus
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Asmodeus
description: : When a creature would attack you, it must make a DC 9 Will save or be unable to. Once per round, you may deal 1d6 extra fire damage on a natural attack.

name: Mark of Phlegethos
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Fierna and Belial
description: : Whenever you take or deal damage, you gain 1 pleasure point. Pleasure points may be spent to add +4 to a roll.

name: Mark of Stygia
prerequisites: Brand of the Nine Hells, alleigance to Levistus
description: : You never need to make Balance checks for slippery surfaces. Gain bonus to attack and damage when you and opponent are standing on ice. You can make weapons deal extra cold damage.

name: Dilate Aura
description: : Once per encounter, you can double the range of your aura.

name: Rapid Regeneration
description: : Your regeneration speed increases by 1.

name: Rapid Regeneration x2
description: No description available.

name: Rapid Regeneration x3
description: No description available.

name: Supernatural Instincts
description: : Creatures you threaten provoke an attack of opportunity for using supernatural abilities.

name: Undo Resistance
prerequisites: Sneak Attack, Sudden Strike, or Skirmish ability
description: : If you successfully deal precision damage with a cold iron weapon, you reduce spell resistance by 1 point per die of bonus damage.

name: Vengeful Surge
description: : When you save against a spell, spell-like ability, or supernatural effect, gain a +2 bonus to damage for 1 round against the creature that targetted you.

name: Devil's Favor
prerequisites: Humanoid or Monstrous Humanoid, Pact with a Devil
description: : 0/day, you may gain a +2 bonus to an attack, save, or check.

name: Devil's Aura
prerequisites: Humanoid or Monstrous Humanoid, Cha 13, Intimidate 9 ranks, Devil's Favor feat
description: : 0/day, you can generate a 10ft aura of fear for 1 round as a swift action. Will DC 9 or become shaken for 1d3 rounds.

name: Devil's Flesh
prerequisites: Humanoid or Monstrous Humanoid, Con 15, Devil's Favor feat
description: : You gain a +0 bonus to natural armor and Intimidate checks. You take the same penalty to Diplomacy checks against good creatures.

name: Devil's Sight
prerequisites: Humanoid or Monstrous Humanoid, Wis 15, Devil's Favor feat
description: : Gain 60ft Darkvision, or improve your existing Darkvision by 60ft. 0/day, you may gain 30ft blindsight for 5 rounds.

name: Devil's Stamina
prerequisites: Humanoid or Monstrous Humanoid, base Fortitude save +3, Devil's Favor feat
description: : You gain 0 extra hit points. Once per day you may gain Fast Healing 0 for 5 rounds.

name: Devil's Tongue
prerequisites: Humanoid or Monstrous Humanoid, Cha 15, Devil's Favor feat
description: : 0/day, you may daze an opponent within 60ft and make the flatfooted for a round (Will DC 9 negates).

name: Divine Censure
prerequisites: Ability to turn undead, good alignment
description: : You may spend a turn attempt to force all evil Outsiders within 30ft to make a DC 9 Will save or become shaken for 1 rounds.

name: Divine Defiance
prerequisites: Ability to turn or rebuke undead, Divine caster level 3rd
description: : You may spend a turn attempt to counter a spell or spell-like ability, using the normal counterspell rules.

name: Persistant Refusal
prerequisites: Ability to turn or rebuke undead
description: : You may expend a turn attempt to gain a second save against an ongoing effect targetting you.

name: Pious Defiance
prerequisites: Ability to turn or rebuke undead
description: : You may expend a turn attempt to gain a +0 bonus on Will saves for one round.

name: Disrupting Spell
description: : A Disrupting Spell reduces the save DC of any spell, spell-like or supernatural ability the target or targets can use by 2.

name: Savage Species
description: No description available.

name: Area Attack
description: : You can use your great size and strength to pick up a heavy object and attack an area as a standard action.

name: Assume Supernatural Ability
prerequisites: Wis 13, ability to assume a new form magically.
description: : You learn to use a single supernatural ability of another kind of creature while assuming its form through a polymorph spell or a similar effect.

name: Improved Assume Supernatural Ability
prerequisites: Wis 17, Assume Supernatural Ability, ability to assume a new form magically.
description: : This feat functions like Assume Supernatural Ability, except that you do not take the -2 penalty on all attack rolls, saves, skill checks, and ability checks when using it.

name: Blowhard
description: : As an attack action, you can use your breath to affect all creatures in a cone 5 feet in length per point of your Constitution bonus.

name: Controlled Respiration
prerequisites: Time limit on how long you can remain out of water, Endurance.
description: : You can control your breathing so as to remain out of water for a longer period of time than you otherwise could. Double the normal time limit after which you must begin making Constitution checks to avoid suffocation.

name: Crush
description: : As a standard action, you can jump or fall onto opponents, using your whole body to crush them. This attack is useful only against creatures at least three size categories smaller than yourself.

name: Cumbrous Dodge
description: : You may activate this feat as a free action. You gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class for the rest of the current encounter. At the end of the encounter, you are fatigued.

name: Cumbrous Fortitude
description: : Before rolling a Fortitude save, you can decide to activate this feat, which gives you a +6 bonus on your saving throw. After the saving throw is resolved, regardless of the result, you are staggered until the end of the encounter.

name: Cumbrous Reflexes
description: : Before rolling a Reflex save, you can decide to activate this feat, which gives you a +6 bonus on your saving throw. After the saving throw is resolved, regardless of the result, you are prone and dazed.

name: Cumbrous Will
description: : Before rolling a Will save, you can decide to activate this fear, which gives you a +6 bonus on your saving throw. After the saving throw is resolved, regardless of the result, you are shaken until the end of the encounter.

name: --Fling Enemy--
description: : You can make a grapple check at a -20 penalty against an opponent at least two size categories smaller than you. The range increment for the thrown creature is 120 feet.

name: Gape Of The Serpent
description: : You can swallow a creature of up to your own size category Like a snake, you can stretch your mouth to an outlandish extent to accommodate immense prey.

name: Great Flyby Attack
description: : Using this feat is a full-round action. When flying, you can move up to your fly speed in a straight line and attack a number of opponents equal to your Dexterity bonus.

name: Improved Flyby Attack
prerequisites: Fly speed, Dodge, Flyby Attack, Mobility.
description: : When flying, you can take a move action (including a dive) and another partial action at any point during the move. If this partial action is an attack, you incur no attacks of opportunity for moving through areas threatened by your target.

name: Improved Scent
description: : You can detect approaching enemies and sniff out hidden foes within 60 feet. For strong scents such as smoke or rotting garbage, double these ranges. Overpowering scents, such as skunk musk or troglodyte stench can be detected at triple normal range.

name: Uncanny Scent
description: : You can pinpoint the location of a scent when within 20 feet

name: Inured To Energy
prerequisites: Resistance to the energy type you specify when taking the feat.
description: : Your existing resistance to one type of energy, increases by 10. You can use this feat only to enhance existing resistances, not to gain resistance to a new type of energy.

name: Involuntary Rage
description: :  If you survive 50 points of damage from a single attack and make your Fortitude save, on your next action you gain +4 to Strength, +4 to Constitution, and -2 to Armor Class.

name: Mighty Leaping
prerequisites: Str 21, Dodge, Mobility, jump 9 ranks or a racial bonus on Jump checks.
description: : You gain a +10 competence bonus on Jump checks. If you intentionally jump down from a height, a successful Jump check (DC 15) lets you take damage as if you had fallen 20 feet less than you actually did.

name: Pain Mastery
description: : You take damage normally, but every 50 points of damage you take (if you survive the attack) automatically increases your Strength by +2. This bonus lasts until the end of the encounter, after which you are exhausted.

name: --Power Dive--
description: : When flying, you can dive and land on an opponent to deal additional damage.

name: Reverberation
description: : Add +2 to the DC of all saving throws against your sonic attack.

name: Roll With It
description: : You gain damage reduction 2/-. This applies in addition to any damage reduction you have from other sources. Damage reduction cannot reduce damage you take to less than 0.

name: Roll With It x2
description: : You gain damage reduction 2/-. This applies in addition to any damage reduction you have from other sources. Damage reduction cannot reduce damage you take to less than 0.

name: Roll With It x3
description: : You gain damage reduction 2/-. This applies in addition to any damage reduction you have from other sources. Damage reduction cannot reduce damage you take to less than 0.

name: Scramble
prerequisites: Dex 15, Small size or smaller, improved evasion
description: : Once per day, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points or less by damage in combat, you can attempt to scramble our of the way. This requires a Reflex saving throw (DC 10 + damage dealt). If the save is successful, you avoid the damage entirely.

name: Stamp
prerequisites: Huge size, feet, trample special attack
description: : You may, as a full-round action, strike a solid surface with one of your limbs and create a shock wave that radiates our from your position and continues for a number of feet equal to 5 x your base creature’s Hit Dice.

name: Supernatural Transformation
description: : One of your innate spell-like abilities becomes a supernatural ability. It is no longer subject to spell resistance, though it can still be suppressed in an antimagic field.

name: Thunderclap
prerequisites: Str 30, Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack
description: : You may, as a full-round action, clap two of your limbs together and create a cone of sound that starts at your position and continues our for a number of feet equal to 5 x your Hit Dice.

name: Vicious Wound
description: : When using an attack that has a wounding special ability, the wounds you cause bleed for an additional point of damage each round.

name: Deep Denizen
description: : Living underground has made you more reliant on nonvisual senses than surface dwellers. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Listen checks and a +4 competence bonus when tracking by scent.

name: Desert Dweller
description: : As a desert dweller, you are more hardy than those who live in mote gentle climates. Your Fortitude save DC to avoid subdual damage from heat is reduced to 10.

name: Grass Trekker
description: : You are a nomad of the steppes, used to traveling long distances, often on foot. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Jump checks. In addition, you do not need to make Fortitude saves when making a forced march until you have traveled for 12 hours.

name: Peak Hopper
description: : Your alpine environment has made you more surefooted. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Balance and Climb checks.

name: Swamp Stalker
description: : You move easily through the sucking bogs and stagnant water of the swamps. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Swim checks and on Strength checks to break free of nets, webs, entangle spells, and similar hindrances.

name: Treefriend
description: : You are completely at home in the forest. You gain a +2 competence bonus on Climb checks and on Survival checks to avoid becoming lost in the forest.

name: Winter's Child
description: : The DC of your Fortitude save to avoid subdual damage from cold is reduced to 10. In addition, you can make a saving throw each minute (DC 10, +1 for each previous check) to resist the effects of hypothermia in very cold water.

name: Bonus Breath
prerequisites: Breath weapon with limited uses per day, Extend Spell or Extend Spell-like Ability.
description: : You can breathe one additional time per day. The interval you must wait between breaths is 1 hour.

name: Detach
description: : As an attack action, you can detach a portion of your body that can make a melee attack other than a bite and use it as a thrown weapon (range increment 20 feet). The thrown member deals its base damage plus your Strength bonus.

name: Dust Cloud
prerequisites: Dex 19, Int 19, Huge size, Combat Reflexes, wings or tail.
description: : As an attack action, you can sweep a limb across the ground and create a dust cloud. This hemispherical cloud has a radius in feet equal to 20 x your Hit Dice.

name: Extended Reach
prerequisites: Small or larger size, nonrigid body or a nonrigid attack form such as a tentacle, feeler, or pseudopod.
description: : Your body or a part of your body with which you can deliver a melee attack is boneless and flexible, allowing you to threaten a larger than normal area with melee attacks. Add +5 feet to your normal reach.

name: Extra Item Space
description: : You can wear one additional magic item beyond the normal limit for the item type in question. The multiple limbs you have must correspond to the limb on which that item type is normally worn.

name: Final Strike
prerequisites: Acid, air, cold, earth, electricity, fire, or water subtype.
description: : When you are killed, your body explodes in a final strike - a blast of elemental destruction. Everything within 60 feet is subject to the effect. Your final strike deals 1d6 points of damage per Hit Die, up to a maximum of 20d6.

name: --Improved Multiattack--
description: : The usual -5 penalty on attack rolls for secondary attacks does not apply to your secondary attacks with natural weapons. The damage bonus for such attacks is still only 1/2 your Strength bonus, if any.

name: Improved Multiweapon Fighting
prerequisites: Dex 15, three arms, BAB +9, Multiattack, Multiweapon Fighting
description: : In addition to the single extra attack you get each round with each off-hand weapon from Multiweapon Fighting, you get a second extra attack with each such weapon, albeit at a -5 penalty.

name: Greater Multiweapon Fighting
prerequisites: Dex 19, three arms, BAB +15, Improved Multiweapon Fighting, Multiweapon Fighting, Multiattack
description: : You may make up to three attacks with each off-hand weapon that you wield, albeit with a -10 penalty on the third attack with each such weapon.

name: --Improved Turn Resistance--
description: : You are less easily affected by clerics or paladins than you normally would be. When resolving turn, rebuke, command, or bolster attempt, add 4 to your character level to determine your Hit Dice for turn, rebuke, command, and bolster attempts.

name: Improved Web
prerequisites: Ability to create webs as an extraordinary ability at least twice per day.
description: : Add +2 to the DC to escape or burst your webs. You may take a full-round action to attack with your webs, you may attack one additional target per point of Dexterity bonus you have. Using this feat requires two of the daily uses of your web ability

name: Irresistible Gaze
description: : Add +2 to the DC of all saving throws against your gaze attack.

name: Piercing Gaze
prerequisites: Cha 15, Int 13, gaze special attack, Irresistible Gaze.
description: : Because of the sheer force of your presence, you add 30 feet to the range of your gaze attack.

name: Mighty Roar
prerequisites: Animal or magical beast; Large size.
description: : Once per day, as a standard action, you can affect every opponent within 30 feet of you that can hear your roar and has a character level lower than yours. An affected opponent must make a successful Will save to negate the effect.

name: Greater Mighty Roar
prerequisites: Animal or magical beast; Large size, Mighty Roar.
description: : This feat functions like Mighty Roar, except that each opponent that fails a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Cha modifier) is panicked for 2d6 rounds.

name: Multigrab
description: : When grappling an opponent with the part of your body that made the attack, you take only a -10 penalty on grapple checks to maintain the hold.

name: Greater Multigrab
description: : When grappling an opponent with only the part of your body that made the attack, you take no penalty on grapple checks to maintain the hold.

name: Rending Constriction
prerequisites: Str 19, Dex 15, constrict ability, improved grab, Greater Multigrab, Multigrab, two constricting limbs.
description: : If you maintain a hold with more than one appendage on an opponent and are able to constrict, you can make a rend attack automatically dealing double the base damage for a constrict attack, and the damage bonus is 1 1/2 times your Strength bonus

name: Multitasking
prerequisites: Dex 15, Int 15, four or more arms, Improved Multiweapon Fighting, Multiattack, Multiweapon Fighting
description: : If you have four or more arms, you can use each pair of arms to perform a distinct partial action. All such partial actions occur simultaneously.

name: Multivoice
prerequisites: Dex 15, Int 15, two or more heads, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting, Multiattack, Quicken Spell, Two-Weapon Fighting
description: : As a full-round action, you can cast one additional spell each round. Each spell used in this way must have a casting time of 1 action.

name: Narrowed Gaze
description: : You may choose to limit your gaze attack to an active gaze. Doing so prevents you from accidentally affecting friends with your gaze.

name: Pervasive Gaze
description: : A creature that averts its eyes has only a 25% chance to avoid the need for a saving throw against your gaze attack.

name: Poison Resistance
prerequisites: Poison special attack as an extraordinary ability
description: : You gain a +2 competence bonus on your Fortitude saves to resist the effects of poison. If a creature of the same kind as you produces the poison, this bonus is +4 instead, assuming that you are not already immune to the poison of your own kind.

name: Prehensile Tail
description: : You can use your tail as an extra "hand." It can grasp melee weapons and use them in combat, although the normal penalties for using an off-hand weapon apply.

name: Rapid Breath
prerequisites: Breath weapon, Quicken Spell or Quicken Spell-like Ability
description: : The required interval between uses of your breath weapon is reduced by 1 round.

name: Surrogate Spellcasting
description: : You complete the verbal and somatic components of spells by substituting vocalizations and gestures appropriate to your shape. You must still have suitable appendages and vocal organs.

name: Thick-skinned
description: : Your existing damage reduction improves by 2.

name: Thick-skinned x2
description: : Your existing damage reduction improves by 2.

name: Thick-skinned x3
description: : Your existing damage reduction improves by 2.

name: Virulent Poison
prerequisites: Poison attack as an extraordinary ability
description: : Add +2 to the DC for Fortitude saving throws against your poison attack.

name: Deadly Poison
prerequisites: Con 19, poison special attack that deals ability damage as secondary damage, Virulent Poison
description: : Your poison attack has the potential to deal more potent secondary damage than it otherwise could. If the subject of the attack fails the second saving throw, the poison deals double its normal secondary damage.
